_about.purpose: Held-out evaluation set for the cross-encoder relevance classifier. Separate from workspace_samples.json on purpose: engine.py's calibrate_threshold() calibrates the live per-goal threshold against workspace_samples.json, so evaluating on that same file would be calibrating and testing on identical data. This file is never read by runtime code.
_about.format: Window strings use the live format engine.py builds at line 111: 'AppName - Window Title'.

categories.focused: Windows that genuinely serve the goal. Expected ON TASK.
categories.distraction: Clearly unrelated windows, no shared vocabulary with the goal. Expected OFF TASK.
categories.hard_negative: Genuinely off task, but deliberately sharing vocabulary with the goal. Probes the word-overlap false positive failure mode. Expected OFF TASK.

_about.editing: Hand editable. Add or correct samples freely; the runner derives all counts from this file and assumes nothing about list lengths.
_about.limitation: Title-only. These are window strings, not captured on-screen text, so this set cannot measure whether accessibility-API enrichment helps or hurts. See notes/CogAlign_Model_Testing_Log.md.
